title: Du'a and Tahneek: Sunnahs of Welcoming the Newborn
summary: From the guidance of the Prophet ﷺ is tahneek of the newborn and making du'a for barakah for him (Sahih al-Bukhari 5467). Many jurists consider the adhan in his ear recommended, though hadith scholars differ over the authenticity of its hadith. These practices are not mere rituals but the parent's first steps in caring for this amanah. If your child is already past the newborn days, making du'a for barakah and righteousness for him remains an open door every day of his life.
try_this: Today: Make a special du'a for your child ("O Allah, make him among the righteous") while you hold him, and make this your daily habit.
reflection_prompts: What du'a have you chosen for your child?
How do you feel when you make du'a for him?
